About the network

Connecting nature across North London.

Nature North London is a new network for nature bringing together community groups, conservation organisations, land managers, forums and organisations working to create, restore and protect urban biodiversity in the areas surrounding Hampstead Heath.

While each group is doing vital work in its own patch, together, we could link habitats, amplify impact, strengthen our voice, and accelerate nature’s recovery across North London.

Our geography

The area
we cover.

Nature North London focuses on the area radiating out from Hampstead Heath.

This is a uniquely powerful geography – anchored by an 800-acre semi-wild heathland, often described as the lungs of London, with its mosaic of woodland, wetland, meadow, scrub and heath.

Our shared ambition

What’s the
big idea?

Turning London into one of the greenest and most biodiverse cities in Europe is a huge ambition – and one that can only be achieved when community groups, volunteers, local authorities, landowners, institutions, developers and funders work together.

Nature North London proposes to use Hampstead Heath as a living ecological core, from which wildlife corridors and stepping stones radiate outward, reconnecting fragmented habitats and communities.

By working collectively, we could:

  • Potentially quadruple the ecological reach of Hampstead Heath for insects, birds, mammals and plants
  • Create a “spider’s web” of connected nature across parks, housing estates, schools, streets, railways, private gardens, businesses and community spaces
  • Identify and strengthen key stepping stones and corridors that already exist – and create new ones where gaps remain
  • Support and empower local groups through shared knowledge, contacts, ideas, tools and encouragement
  • Build a stronger collective voice to influence policy, planning, Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), land management and funding decisions
  • Help make a large area of North London function, in practice, like a joined-up urban nature reserve – improving biodiversity, air quality, flood resilience and climate adaptation
  • Deepen people’s connection with nature and with each other, fostering pride, wellbeing and stewardship

Nature North London is not a new organisation competing for attention or resources. It is a collaborative platform for any group or institution willing to actively work towards these shared goals – in ways that suit their capacity.
